\caption{Discrepancy of diffused Nitsche from each body-fitted P1 solution at octree depth 8. $\eta_{\mathrm{rig}}$ and $\eta^{H^1}_{\mathrm{rig}}$: relative $L^2$ and $H^1$ norms of the displacement difference after removing its best-fit rigid motion (in \%); $\ell_{\mathrm N}/\ell_{\mathrm{P1}}$: compliance ratio (below 1: Nitsche stiffer); $s_{95}$, $s_{99}$: Nitsche-to-P1 ratios of the 95th and 99th percentiles of the von Mises stress. Flags, at the session's $h_{\min}$: T, wall thinner than $4h_{\min}$; G, gaps narrower than $h_{\min}$ on over 1\% of the surface; L, a load within $3h_{\min}$ of a support; S, a support piece below $50h_{\min}^2$ or a partial clamp on a section thinner than $4h_{\min}$; blank, unflagged. Gray rows: $\eta_{\mathrm{rig}}$ above 10\% against at least one mesh. ---, no body-fitted mesh (the input surface self-intersects). $^{\dagger}$ Nitsche solve converged only to $10^{-2}$; excluded from the medians. Medians over all objects and over the unflagged ones; $n$, number of values. Details in Section~S\ref{si:error-comparison}.}\label{tab:si-bf-accuracy-d8}\\
